# DELETE /api/v1/admin/unadopted/{owner}/{repo}

Deletes unadopted repository files from the filesystem

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (token with AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin) · **ID:** `ep-109`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Non-admin user
- **404** — User not found, repo already in DB, or git repo not on disk
- **500** — DB error or deletion failure

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | admin.DeleteUnadoptedRepository | controller | Get owner username and repo name from path; Lookup user by name; Check repo does NOT exist in DB; Check git repo DOES exist on disk; Call repo_service.DeleteUnadoptedRepository |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.DeleteUnadoptedRepository | service | Validate repo name is usable; Check git repo exists on disk; Check repo does NOT exist in DB; Delete git repository directory from storage |
